pending_interview.question: You have a list of log entries, each containing a user ID (a string) and a timestamp (an integer representing seconds). Write a function that finds the user who appears most frequently within any sliding 10-minute window across the entire log. Describe your approach, explain the data structures you'd choose and why, and analyze the time and space complexity (that is, how runtime and memory use grow as the input size grows) of your solution.
